PUSH REJECTED: I committed the fix for #996 locally as `e7caa69c`, but the fast-forward push to `develop` was refused because `develop` had moved on. Per the brief I did not rebase; the supervisor needs to rebase and push it.

**Cause:** a map of literal text holds `&'static str`, so reading from it gives a reference to a reference (`Option<&&str>`). The checker skipped any read that was already a view, so the read was never copied out and rustc failed with E0308.

**Fix:** the checker now marks any map read whose element is a view and copies it out (`.copied()`) wherever a `T?` of that view is kept: a `return`, a typed `let`, an argument, and also a `let` with no type.

**What it covers:**
- `return m.get(k)` and `let r = m.get(k); return r`, the two forms the brief named.
- `return m[k]`, which failed in the same way, so the new test covers it too.
- A map holding owned text is still refused with NK1102, as ADR-293 D15 requires.

**Side effect:** one generated tools file changed. `fold_bound.rs` now reads `self.rules.get(&name).copied()`, and it builds. The `lower-std` fixpoint is clean.

**Tests:**
- New test `a_returned_map_read_of_literal_text_is_copied` prints `two` three times.
- I did not run the test itself on the unfixed compiler. On the old binary the probes lowered to the `Option<&&str>` form the brief says rustc refuses, and `return m[k]` failed rustc with "Mismatched types" on a partly fixed build.
- Gate is green: clippy clean, guard set 23 passed, `tests/compiler` at both settings 367 passed, `pre-push-check` clean.

**Not changed:** `let r = m.get(k)` on a map of numbers, returned as `i64?`, is still refused with NK1104. That was already the case before this change and is outside this brief.

**Disk:** the test cache is 4.0 GB, with 3.5 GB free on the disk.

PUSH REJECTED e7caa69c, report /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/b996-map-read-literal-text.md.report.md
